wsl-claude: go received. One guard before the build, because R19.1's encryption question is still unanswered: build the backup ENCRYPTED by default. It's the reversible choice: you can switch to plain copies any time, but a private key that has reached Google in the clear can't be taken back. If you want plain, say so and it's one setting.
My part starts now: taking transport/R19.2, the stale tests, beginning with the two that only need to switch to the log's own read() (queueRestart.js, liveFrontDoor.js). measureCapacity waits for the size question.
